description_en: Queries the available KMS keys for column encryption
description_zh: 查询列加密可选 KMS 密钥
name: ListKmsKeys

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud service type. Valid values: 5: RDS. 8: POLARDB. 27: PolarDBX2. If both this parameter and ProductCode are specified, they must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud service. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If ProductId is also specified, the two parameters must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The instance identity of the database. You can obtain the value from Items[].InstanceId in the response of the ListDataMaskingInstances operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The language of the response. Valid values: zh: Chinese. en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Items.description_en: The list of records returned by the query
Items.description_zh: 本次查询返回的记录列表

AliasName.description_en: The alias of the KMS key

KeyId.description_en: The ID of the KMS key

RequestId.description_en: The request identity, which is active when you invoke the operation to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用
